summary: Phase 1 DHL PNG Demo — Backend (16/16 pytest tests passing) and Frontend (auth flows, dashboard, sidebar coming-soon pages, register, forgot-password, protected route, logout) all working as expected. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: passlib '__about__' warning at startup is non-fatal (per problem statement) but should be cleaned by pinning passlib>=1.7.5 with bcrypt<4 OR using bcrypt directly. Not blocking.
All routes correctly prefixed with /api. OpenAPI publicly exposed at /api/openapi.json ✓
Response models (UserPublic, TokenResponse) properly exclude _id and password hash ✓
Frontend correctly stores JWT in localStorage key 'dhl_auth_token' (raw token, no Bearer prefix). AuthContext hydrates via /api/auth/me on mount ✓
ProtectedRoute correctly redirects unauthenticated /dashboard access to /login ✓
All 10 sidebar coming-soon pages render with data-testid='coming-soon-page' and 'coming-soon-icon' ✓
DEMO MODE badge present on landing, /login, /register, /forgot-password, and /dashboard ✓
test_credentials: demo@dhlpng.com / Demo@2026 (seeded). New registrations also tested with test-{ts}@example.com / Strong1Pass.
seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ users via /api/auth/register during testing. Not cleaned up (no admin endpoint), but data is isolated to /test_database.

backend_passed: GET /api/openapi.json public + lists all auth paths
POST /api/auth/login success returns access_token + full user (no _id, no password)
POST /api/auth/login wrong password -> 401 'Invalid email or password'
GET /api/auth/me valid token returns all 8 fields (id, email, firstName, lastName, companyName, country, phone, createdAt)
POST /api/auth/register success -> 201, auto-login token works against /me
frontend_passed: Landing renders hero, track widget, DHL yellow pill logo, demo badge
Empty track input shows 'Please enter a tracking number' toast
Track with input shows 'next phase' info toast
/login with demo creds -> /dashboard + token stored in localStorage 'dhl_auth_token'
/login wrong password stays on /login with error
/register fills all fields, password strength meter visible, T&C checkbox + submit -> auto-login redirect to /dashboard
Country (Papua New Guinea) and +675 phone prefix visible/locked on /register
Dashboard: welcome with firstName (Demo), 4 KPI cards (kpi-*), 4 quick actions (quick-ship-now/quick-track/quick-quote/quick-pickup)
Quick Action click -> 'comes online in the next phase' info toast
Notification bell click -> 'No new notifications / You're all caught up' toast
All 10 sidebar items (track/ship/quote/pickup/shipments/addresses/invoices/reports/customs/settings) render coming-soon-page + coming-soon-icon
Account dropdown logout clears localStorage 'dhl_auth_token' and redirects to /login
Protected /dashboard route redirects to /login when unauthenticated
DEMO MODE badge visible bottom-right on /, /login, /register, /forgot-password, /dashboard
notes: Bell toast test occasionally collides with the welcome toast queue — add ~3-4s wait between toasts in playwright. Not a bug.

Account dropdown menu uses Radix Portal — data-testid='account-dropdown-menu' is on DropdownMenuContent and appears in portal root. Direct .count() can return 0 if the portal is rendered outside the expected scope or closed by other actions; the dropdown-logout button works correctly when clicked sequentially after trigger.
DEMO MODE badge is partially behind 'Made with Emergent' badge in screenshots — visual stacking only, expected per problem statement.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_api.py (pytest, 16 tests, all green). Demo user seeded on startup. JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env. Frontend testids cheatsheet: login-{email-input|password-input|submit-button|forgot-link|register-link}, register-{firstname|lastname|email|password|confirm-password|company|phone|tnc-checkbox|submit-button}-input, forgot-{email-input|submit-button|success}, hero-{track-input|track-submit|signin-link|ship-cta}, sidebar-link-{kebab-label-from-DashboardLayout-items} (e.g., sidebar-link-track-shipment, sidebar-link-ship-now, sidebar-link-customs-documents), kpi-{label-kebab}, quick-{ship-now|track|quote|pickup}, notification-bell, account-dropdown-trigger, dropdown-logout, dropdown-settings, demo-mode-badge, coming-soon-page, coming-soon-icon.
